# Kartogo

> Kartogo is a hyperlocal 15-minute delivery service in Ongole, Andhra Pradesh. We deliver snacks, pickles, instant food, spice powders, pooja items, tiffin batter and daily essentials from neighbourhood makers.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Shop essentials with 15-minute delivery in Ongole.
- [Categories](/categories): Browse all product categories — snacks, pickles, spices, pooja items, tiffin batter and more.
- [Search](/search): Search the Kartogo catalog.
- [Print Store](/print): Local print & stationery on-demand.
- [Support](/support): Help, contact and refund information.
- [Refund & Returns](/refund-returns): Refund and returns policy.

## Optional

- [Wishlist](/wishlist): Saved items (requires login).
